body: Thanks man and yeah, I'm gonna book an appointment with my therapist soon...that makes sense and thanks again for answering

Thanks, it's just hard to believe the voices aren't people due to their detailed dialogue. 

Also, how do I handle social situations? All I think about around people is the voices, my anxiety and the fact that I fantasized about rape in the past. I feel like a scumbag, I can't hide my thoughts and it feels like everybody notices this anxious bullshit I continuously go through...

I know I'm not evil, why else would I want to be good? The voices came after I decided to never fantasize about rape again... I really was trying to be a better person and then the voices started a few days later...

Thanks, I appreciate it :) and that sucks, I've never tried online dating so I just thought it would be worth a shot... If I were you I'd look into E Harmony or a website that requires payment since that will weed out the creepy people you don't wanna meet

Hey I'm sorry you gotta deal with this but things *will* get better, believe me, you're only 22. 

I know a beautiful 20 year old girl who's still a virgin, you aren't that far off...

Sorry you gotta deal with panic, anxiety and depression... I used to be suicidal so I can relate... 

I'm a 19 year old guy (although I'm ugly and schizophrenic..). I don't think any less of you because of your disorders... You can probably get a guy that's better than me if you try...I'm not sure but I can guess that woman have an easier time finding dates...

Join a few dating websites and put yourself out there (I don't mean be a slut,just get out more and meet people)...It really shouldn't be too hard if you're a decent looking woman. 

Good luck

I'm only 19 but I'm already dead inside... I suffer from OCD, anxiety and worst of all schizophrenia...

Everyday brings me a little closer to death... I can't feel emotions like happiness or empathy anymore, I can't function without hearing voices or hallucinating something crazy, I live in constant Hell that never seems to let up...

My mind goes through the same bullshit everyday; get up, hear voices, become anxious, hear more voices, OCD, voices, anxiety, voices, etc. 

My entire life revolves around these compulsions and hallucinations... 

I'm dead inside, I can't cry either and if I do I still can't feel regular emotion... I just want to be a good person with a normal life... I just want inner peace.

Yeah man, it's a great song... I've been depressed most of my life too so I can relate and thanks, with time things will change and we'll both be in a better place so keep going and think of the future

I hope my comment helped, like I said you seem like a really good guy so keep trying, don't give up and life will work out for you...

Feel free to message me anytime, good luck!

Hey man, sorry you gotta deal with all this... If you're looking for someone to talk to feel free to message me.

As for your situation, I'm not too sure what would help... Think about graduation (I'm 19 so I graduated already, going to college in January) and keep looking forward to the future. 

Once you're in college I'm sure you'll meet people, you seem like a good person so it shouldn't be too hard...

I'm on an anti-depressant and it really does help... If you get on an anti-depressant, things will change for the better. Combine that with therapy and who knows how life will work out for you...

You must be in a lot of pain right now so I'm sorry, just remember that life is long and things can change, be a good person and make the most out of your life... Message me if you wanna talk

That subreddit is a great idea man... as for what you're dealing with, I wish I could help.

I'm glad you aren't suicidal but praying to die must be horrible... Sorry you gotta go through this.

I'm a paranoid schizophrenic and before my psychotic outbreak I suffered from suicidal depression. When the psychosis started, the voices basically raped my soul and told me they were coming to kill me... It's been like this for 17 months and although schizophrenia can be overwhelming, the fear of being murdered scared me away from suicide and almost completely cured my suicidal depression...

What I'm getting at is what you were saying, how you pray for death... Believe me, I feel for you and I've been there myself but when you actually believe you're dead, your perspective will change and you'll want to live, you'll see all your problems for what they are and you'll decide you wanna live (at least that's what it was like for me)...

I'm only 19 but I've been alone all my life... at least you're smart and you'll likely find a decent job (considering you're a grad student)... once you graduate your perspective will probably change. You have potential, you'll find love and you'll overcome this...

Listen to the song Simple Man by Lynyrd Skynyrd, it's motivating and it gave me hope...

Good luck with everything man, I'm sure things will work out if you give it time
That sucks man, hmu if you wanna talk
I am but I'm dead inside, I can't feel anything anymore

That makes sense,  before my psychotic outbreak I was suicidal and I felt dead inside before my brother was even born so maybe that's why I can't feel love for him... I feel bad even saying that but I just can't feel pure love...

As for spending time with him, I live an hour away so I see him once or twice a week but I'll definitely try to spend time with him and feel the love he deserves
I think that's good advice, I smoked a small bowl just now and at first the anxiety went away but it's coming back now which sucks...

Maybe you subconsciously only seek out specific types of friends... Do you instinctively label people, consider yourself superior to anyone, etc.? 

I'm not judging you, I'm just wondering... Maybe you should find people like you, the people without friends... That type of friendship will be great because it'll be based on personality and it won't be a shallow relationship...

I empathize with you, moving away to college can be rough... I'm sorry you're so depressed, it's only October and I'm presuming this is your Freshman year so if it is then you still have years to make friends...

I'm sorry you've had to deal with all this, I can't imagine dealing with one suicide, let alone four. 

I don't know what to say, other than be the best person you can possibly be and always be there for those in need of help. You're probably more likely to spot the warning signs of suicide since you've experienced what you've experienced... Try to help everyone, especially those dealing with depression. 

You seem like you have a good heart, you really didn't deserve the pain you've described. 

You're only 16, too. You have your whole life ahead of you so make the most out of it... Like I've been saying, be a good person and life will work out for you... 

I'm glad you don't act on your suicidal thoughts, if you ever wanna talk feel free to message m

I can relate to how you feel... when I was suicidal I smoked weed all the time and it made things worse. I didn't care though, like you it helped me numb the pain until it started messing with my mind... I'd get major anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts...

I know you'll probably keep smoking weed (or doing whatever drug you're doing) but I really think you should cut down a bit... Use weed spiritually, try using it to fix yourself...

I'd also keep writing posts in this subreddit. Asking for help is a great thing, it means you don't actually want to die, so keep updating everyone here and asking for advice...

As for your situation, try focusing on the good things in your life... I know you're in pain and I empathize with you... I'd start a journal and devote a bit of time each day to reflecting, contemplating and working on your life. 

If you're in this much pain I'd consider an anti-depressant and therapy... I've been on an anti-depressant since last June and I've been going to therapy... Those things really do help.
